svg.aria-label: Claim question to approved payout across Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Foundry and Fabric
svg.title: Claim question to approved payout across Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Foundry and Fabric
svg.text: Claim question to approved payout across Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Foundry and Fabric
A customer asks about coverage; the Foundry orchestrator grounds the answer in policy wording and Fabric data; a payout above the threshold waits for an adjuster's approval

g.data-label: Is my water damage covered? Pay out $9,400?
g.data-tip: The customer asks in Teams or web chat; Copilot Studio signs them in with Entra ID.

g.title: 1. The customer asks in Teams or web chat; Copilot Studio signs them in with Entra ID.

g.data-tip: Copilot Studio calls the AI gateway with the user's token and the case id.

g.title: 2. Copilot Studio calls the AI gateway with the user's token and the case id.

g.data-tip: The policy agent retrieves coverage clauses from the indexed wording.

g.title: 5. The policy agent retrieves coverage clauses from the indexed wording.

g.data-tip: The fraud-signal agent asks the Fabric data agent, which runs governed queries as the signed-in user.

g.title: 6. The fraud-signal agent asks the Fabric data agent, which runs governed queries as the signed-in user.

g.text: threshold is never executed by the
agent: it is routed to a human.

g.data-tip: The action agent calls the claim tool API with the proposed payout.

g.data-tip: The tool API starts the approval flow, which asks an adjuster in Teams.
